title: Apple brings touch to the Mac and publishes its first design guidance for touch on macOS
dek: What changes when a Mac gets tapped, Apple's touch design talk, building a Figma library from code, how Microsoft gave Copilot's icon a voice, and two events.
preheader: The Mac is now a touchscreen. Here's what Apple says that means for your interface.
hero_alt: A labelled section of basic shapes, a teammate dragging a star out
summary: Apple's new MacBook Pro [turns touches into clicks](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-unveils-groundbreaking-macbook-pro-with-proled-xdr-display/) so most apps work on day one, and early hands-ons show a desktop that stays a desktop, with [menu bar items that grow when tapped](https://gizmodo.com/macos-touchscreen-macbook-pro-2000831715). The real homework is Apple's [Touch on Mac guidance](https://developer.apple.com/touch-on-mac/): hit targets, hover and controls that expand under a finger. Elsewhere, Christine Vallaure makes the case for [building your Figma library from code](https://uxdesign.cc/building-an-ai-ready-design-system-library-code-figma-with-mcp-ec5d9e8c90d2), not the other way round.

case.title: More than a mark: how Copilot's icon joined the conversation
case.studio: Microsoft Design, with COLLINS and Koto
case.note: Copilot's icon looked different everywhere and sat still while the AI worked. The team rebuilt it as two simple forms that can move apart and back together, giving it thinking, planning and retrieval states. The deciding rule: a shape in motion has to stay readable in every frame.

steps: Create tokens and text styles first, with the same names the code uses.

learn.title: Let the Mac translate touch, or design for it?
learn.intro: macOS now turns taps into clicks, so most apps work untouched. The call is where that's enough.

columns.label: Let it translate when
items: The screen is mostly standard system controls
Precise work stays on the trackpad anyway
Every action already has a click route

columns.label: Design for touch when
items: People drag, draw or scrub on a canvas
Custom controls are smaller than a fingertip

examples.name: Pixelmator Pro
examples.text: Apple rebuilt it so you draw, paint and select straight on the canvas.

learn.rule: If a finger has to do something a click can't, design it; otherwise let macOS translate.
learn.take: The columns are our framing, built from Apple's announcement and its design for touch session.
